contract_model.adopted: v1.1 amendment 2026-08-17 — no fixed Hudl export preset exists; seven sighted real exports all differ (12/13/26/33/39/43/45 columns)
contract_model.core_rule: core columns were present in all seven sighted exports; ingest MUST fail hard if any core column is missing from a file's header
contract_model.optional_rule: optional canonical columns are validated when present; when absent, ingest materializes them as null columns
contract_model.unknown_rule: header columns not in the canonical set (e.g. TARGET ROUTE, MOTION, SERIES, BF ACTION, TACKLE, comment columns) are ignored with a log notice — contract-neutral, not a violation

file_format.filename_fallback_note: reduced year-only form allowed when the exact date is not reconstructable ('_n' = ordinal on collisions). Export metadata carries NO year (verified 2026-08-17: the only date-bearing field is a tournament label like 'FF - European Championship, Paris - 23.-28.09.' without a year) — the year must travel in the filename
file_format.filename_rules: ISO date first for chronological sort; '_' separates fields, '-' joins tokens within a field; uppercase 3-letter IFAF team codes
file_format.filename_semantics: TEAM1 = Charting-Perspektive-Team im Dateinamen; posteam = TEAM1 wenn ODK == 'O', sonst TEAM2 (einseitig festgelegt 2026-08-17; ratification deferred, see deferred_ratification)

columns.name: PLAY #
columns.note: identity source of play_id; contiguous 1..N per game

columns.name: ODK
columns.note: forward-only hardening; legacy ODK is polluted (team names, formation strings) and takes the grandfathered ingest path

columns.name: YARD LN
columns.note: signed convention: negative = own territory, positive = yards to opponent goal

columns.name: PLAY TYPE
columns.note: column present in all seven sighted exports (hence core presence), values optional; semantics sighting deferred to Phase 1.2

columns.name: RESULT
columns.matching: exact token match after split on separator, case-sensitive
columns.note: non-empty forward-only (23% of legacy plays are empty and silently become 'pass') — confirmed as unilateral working decision 2026-08-17. C-07 amendment: 'No Good' and 'Fumble' added to the C-07 token list; working Fumble semantics: Fumble = charted ball loss tag; possession-change semantics to be confirmed at ratification (see deferred_ratification). Replaces the fragile str.contains substring semantics.

columns.name: GN/LS
columns.note: column present in all seven sighted exports (hence core presence); informational, non-authoritative — yards gained are derived from yardline_50 deltas

columns.name: DEF FRONT
columns.note: sighted 2026-08-17 from 7 sample exports (2 tranches). Three notation families whose boundary does NOT follow own/scouting (v1.1 correction: GER vs. PAN / GER vs. PUE are own games using LINE notation; tuples appeared only in the two EM-Paris films): LINE notation (incl. one transition value 'LINE 5 --> 7'), numeric tuples matching ^\d+(-\d+){3}$ plus 'ALL GL'/'ALL FIRST', and structure calls 'S Dia'/'BOX 4/7'/'LINE 5 POST BOX 4/7' (meaning unknown). Enumeration is open, not closed; column entirely absent in several exports. Vocabulary adopted unilaterally 2026-08-17; notation unification remains an open sighting question, queued for ratification (see deferred_ratification)

columns.name: COVERAGE
columns.normalization: collapse whitespace around hyphens in numeric shells ('F 1 -2-1' -> 'F 1-2-1', 'SC 1 - 2 -1' -> 'SC 1-2-1'); uppercase; typo fix 'YELLOE' -> 'YELLOW' (3x sighted in GER vs. PAN)
columns.note: sighted 2026-08-17 from 7 sample exports: three mixed name spaces — team call colors (incl. prefixed variant 'O WHITE', prefix meaning unknown), numeric zone shells, textbook term 'QUARTERS' (1x in scouting film). Vocabulary adopted unilaterally 2026-08-17; relationship of color calls vs shells and meaning of 'F'/'SC'/'O' prefixes remains an open sighting question, queued for ratification (see deferred_ratification)

columns.name: BLITZ
columns.note: sighted 2026-08-17, confirmed in all 5 exports carrying the column: observed values are exclusively person names (blitzer identified by first or last name), not tactical terms — names are PII and deliberately not enumerated here. '<BLITZERIN-NAME>' is a semantic placeholder, not a literal value. Free-text person reference adopted unilaterally 2026-08-17; forward decision (keep name-based charting = PII column like RECEIVED BY, or switch to a tactical vocabulary) remains an open sighting question, queued for ratification (see deferred_ratification)

columns.name: QTR
columns.note: essentially never filled; not consumed by the pipeline

drive_id.rule: increment on O/D possession flip; scoring/turnover RESULT (TD, Def TD, Safety, Interception, Fumble-if-turnover) also closes a drive

game_id.rule: parsed from filename_pattern; assigned by ingest from parsed filename

posteam.rule: TEAM1 = Charting-Perspektive-Team im Dateinamen; posteam = TEAM1 wenn ODK == 'O', sonst TEAM2
posteam.adopted: einseitig festgelegt 2026-08-17; analyst ratification queued (see deferred_ratification)
posteam.caveat: get_games() currently assumes the team with the first drive is 'home_team' (only relevant for scores/differential)
